phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Get answers to key questions to create blueprint.
macro_deliverables: Blueprint with filled-out hypotheses on each component
Product roadmap and feature backlog developed
Detailed project plan for Pilot/MVP phase

phases.name: Pilot
phases.objective_one_line: Build MVP and launch with small group of users. Test and iterate.
macro_deliverables: Strategic KPIs and rationale decided and aligned with key stakeholders
Key internal hires identified and onboarded
Identification of first customer target group (‘archetype’)
Full business case including detailed implementation plan and roadmap

architect_notes: Engagement type and the 24-week length are the firm's own proposal; every phase and week count rests on them.
The split into 6 and 18 weeks is an estimate; the brief gives only the 24-week total.
The rollout after the pilot is not in these phases.
Not covered by the phases: European Commission, EU plan includes digital product passport acts for construction products. Confirm whether it is in scope.
